name: Alpengasthof Grüner
beschreibung: The Alpengasthof Grüner is situated in Serfaus on a sunny plateau high above the Inn Valley. This family-run property combines traditional alpine architecture with contemporary comfort. The rooms are furnished with local timbers and provide panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. The restaurant serves Austrian and Tyrolean specialities, placing a strong emphasis on regional produce. In summer, the inn serves as a base for hikes and biking tours in the Kaunergrat Nature Park. In winter, guests can take the ski bus directly from the doorstep to the ski lifts of the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis region. A wellness area with a sauna and steam bath complements the offer. Guests can look forward to a tranquil location with immediate access to hiking trails and ski slopes.
